NONE: › (of a woman or female animal) to produce an egg from which a baby can be formed

example: Some women take drugs to help them ovulate.
有些婦女服藥來幫助排卵。

NONE: › the time when a woman or female animal produces an egg
› a part inside the ovary (= organ that produces eggs) of a plant that contains the female sex cell and develops into a seed when that cell is fertilized
胚珠（植物子房中的一部分，產生雌性生殖細胞，受精後變成種子）
› an egg cell produced by a woman or female animal

example: If two ova are fertilized at the same time, the mother will have twins.
如果兩個卵子同時受精，母親就會生出雙胞胎。
